note: Ground-truth evidence for the 12 eval questions, derived by grepping the corpus (pipeline/data/chunks.jsonl, 151 pages, English edition of the FEMSA 2024 Integrated Annual Report). Every page set below was verified by literal string search on the chunk text on 2026-11-25/26; see the verification commands in ragas/README.md. An 'evidence item' is one fact the answer must contain. Items marked outside_corpus do NOT exist anywhere in the 151 pages (verified by grep returning no page). Q3 uses the report's own figure (1,596 net openings, MD&A p.112) instead of the ontology's '1,236 aperturas', which does not appear in the report — same rule the exactness scorer applies. Q7 records the report's own growth figures (32.8% / 31.5%, p.34) as an alternative ground truth alongside the expected 27.5% / 24.9% (4Q24 press release, not in the report).
